newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ says to sell and lease back 45 properties.
newsitem.headline: BNZ says to sell and lease back 45 properties.

text.p: The Bank of New Zealand on Tuesday said it had decided to sell and lease back 45 branch premises following a review of its property holdings.
The review was part of the bank's moves to focus on core banking activities and redirect capital to areas of customer service.

"The programme involves branch properties from around the country collectively worth more than NZ$25 million. Each property will be sold and leased back by the bank under a retail lease for six years, with ongoing rights of renewal," BNZ said in a statement.
Auctions would be held in Auckland on December 10, Wellington on December 11 and Christchurch on December 12.

National property services company Colliers Jardine, which has been contracted to carry out the sale programme, said the portfolio of 45 properties represented a significant opportunity for investors who were looking at acquisitions under NZ$2 million.
